title: fgrf's throwing stones
description: A simple plugin that adds throwable stones for unique PvP combat on your Minecraft server
body:
# Throwable Stones

A fun PvP mechanic perfect for RP-focused servers that adds throwable stone weapons to your server.

## Features
- Craft throwing stones from stone buttons
- Right-click to throw with 0.6s cooldown
- Deals 2 hearts base damage (scales with target's armor)
- Visual particle effects and sounds on impact
- Small knockback effect

## How to Use
1. Craft a stone button
2. Place the stone button back in any crafting grid to create a Throwing Stone
3. Hold the Throwing Stone and right-click to throw
4. Hit players or mobs to deal damage

## Requirements
- Paper 1.21+ (also works on Purpur, Pufferfish, Spigot)
- Java 21+

Perfect for medieval RP servers, prison servers, or adding unique combat mechanics!
